text:
Arre, but status 'In Transit' kaise dikha raha hai? Delivery person toh deke gaya hai mujhe! Woh alag baat hai ki box ekdum crushed tha aur andar se sab tutne ki awaz aa rahi thi. 

Haan, mujhe replacement shipment chahiye ya phir refund process kar do, kyunki carrier-damaged goods hain yeh. Photos bhi maine le liye hain, agar aapko chahiye toh upload kar deta hoon. Please isko escalate karke jaldi se solve kar do.
